statements.text: Amy Howley Reifert enters her 36th year as the Head Women's Soccer Coach at the University of Chicago in the 2026-27 academic year, having established one of the elite women's soccer programs in NCAA Division III.
In her 37 years as a collegiate head coach (UChicago 1991-present, Knox College 1987-89), Howley Reifert owns 432 career wins (424 at UChicago and eight at Knox).
